name: glyph-forge
description: 图片转形状感知ASCII字符画，可拖拽实时调节
interaction: Drop in any image and watch it re-render as a shape-aware ASCII artwork, where character density follows edges and contours rather than a fixed grid. Drag sliders in real time to adjust resolution, contrast, and glyph palette — the ASCII canvas re-forges itself instantly under your cursor.
